item.title: Person living/storing items in bushes, 26th August
item.description:
At different times of the day and evening, the same person ( male) is paying regular visits to his base camp which is to the left of the pergola if you are facing it. He seems to be doing this alone. He is collecting things and dropping items off. His stuff seems to be stored in the bushes, which includes bedding. We know this as a dog had to be brought out of the area yesterday. This character is quite distinct and can be seen around Bermondsey street and London Bridge station areas during the day. This part of the park is now another area which doesn’t feel 100% safe whilst shenanigans like this are happening all through the day and evening.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 4, Leathermarket Street, The Borough, Greater London
